actions_not_performed: No move, delete, canonical install, Git/index edit or compiler launch
actions_performed: Read local preserved policy, README, inventory and plan
Verify manifest hashes and operation set/count/hash/path consistency
implementation_requirements: Use a genuine atomic no-replace rename primitive; existence-check followed by ordinary overwriting rename is insufficient. The revised plan explicitly requires this.

Write and flush per-file intent before rename, reconcile source/destination hashes after interruption, and flush completed receipts. Any stronger crash-durability claim additionally requires appropriate file/directory fsync.
Rollback must also use no-replace semantics and refuse changed archives or recreated original paths.
Parent must independently confirm the listed candidate gates and review the eventual executor before relocation.
policy_assessment: Preserving untracked trials under research with honest status follows the policy; no tracked work is deleted.
Snapshot alone does not authorize stale execution: refreshed HEAD/index/source guards and coordinated exclusive canonical writers remain mandatory.
The plan keeps root installation, manifests, staging and proof acceptance separate; no final verification gate is asserted by this review.
